entry.title: LUFest 0.1.1
entry.summary: LUFest 0.1.1 - first release (test build). Loudness meter effect for the master on Akai Force / MPC OS 3.x. Install: unzip, copy to the Force, run install.sh as root (INSTALL.md inside). Not verified: loudness numbers not yet checked against a reference; not yet run on a Force; master tap point (before/after fader) unknown - see docs/USER-GUIDE.md.
